question: Which of the following indicators is NOT directly included in the calculation of the Human Development Index (HDI)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Infant mortality rate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Human Development Index (HDI)** is a composite index used to measure and rank countries' levels of social and economic development. It focuses on three core dimensions: **health, education, and standard of living**.
 
• The health dimension is assessed by **life expectancy at birth**, which serves as a proxy for the overall health and longevity of a population.
 
• The education dimension is calculated using two indicators: **mean years of schooling** (average number of years of education received by people aged 25 and older) and **expected years of schooling** (years of schooling a child is expected to receive).
 
• The standard of living dimension is evaluated through **Gross National Income (GNI) per capita**, adjusted for purchasing power parity (PPP).
